title: Typing indicators and cursors: presence vs. broadcast

competitor.concept: Presence — a Realtime channel feature (`channel.track(state)` / `presenceState()`) that syncs each connected client's shared key-value state to every other subscriber until `untrack()`, channel leave, or disconnect. It does not expire on user idle, so typing requires explicit track/untrack choreography.

Broadcast — a Realtime channel feature (`channel.send({ type: 'broadcast', event, payload })`) for ephemeral, high-frequency messages (cursor position, drag state) that are fanned out to subscribers and not held as reconciled per-client state.
